# grep-index-prune

The daily `checks.grep-index-prune` job: runs `pruneGrepIndex` (`checks/cli`)
in a supervised child, main only — deletes the shared grep index's answers and
folds unread for 14 days, a page at a time, each page's deletes one short
transaction. No check run prunes: the prune used to run inside the first store
open of each UTC day, so the check runs opening the store just after midnight
raced for its whole-table DELETEs and waited behind them. Each run logs one
line to `logs/check-grep-index-prune.jsonl`.

- Description: The daily checks.grep-index-prune job: on main, deletes the shared grep index's rows unread for 14 days — a page at a time, off every check run's path.
- Server:
  - Uses:
    - `infra/jobs/supervised-job.defineSupervisedJob`

  - Register: `defineSupervisedJob('checks.grep-index-prune')`
- Cli:
  - Uses: `framework/tooling/checks.pruneGrepIndex`
